title: B2B Digital Product Passport: Architecture for EU Regulations
body:
Is your factory ready for the imminent Digital Product Passport (DPP) required by Europe?

Starting in 2026, the European Union will require components, batteries, and textiles to have an immutable digital record regarding their lifecycle and ecological footprint. If you manufacture or distribute in B2B, generating a dynamic QR code for each batch is not the problem; the technical hell is hosting, structuring, and serving millions of concurrent digital passports every time an auditor, a client, or customs scans your products. If your database collapses, the merchandise does not move and you lose million-dollar contracts.

The trap of traditional ERPs and traceability plugins

Most manufacturers try to force their ERP (like SAP or Navision) to generate and expose these passports through improvised web portals. The result: saturated servers, response times of several seconds per scan, and vulnerabilities in the exposure of confidential industrial data. An ERP is built to manage internal accounting, not to serve millions of public queries in real-time.

Our solution: Headless Architecture for B2B DPP

At LANZAESTUDIO.ES, we decouple the digital passport generation from your internal software. We design an ultra-fast NoSQL database architecture, fed via API by your ERP, which serves manufacturing, material, and recyclability data in milliseconds through a global Content Delivery Network (CDN).

  1. DPP-Oriented Data Modeling: We structure lifecycle information according to the European standard, using document databases to adapt to the different regulations of each product family.
  2. Asynchronous Ingestion Cloud API: Your ERP sends production data to our Message Queue without blocking, generating digital passports in the background.
  3. Distributed Edge Caching: We serve the QR code content directly from perimeter nodes (Edge Computing). Customs in Germany or clients in Spain will access the DPP instantly.
  4. Zero Trust Isolation and Security: Whoever scans the QR only accesses the public product information. Your suppliers' critical data remains encrypted and invisible.

The Real Impact on your B2B Operations

  • Guaranteed regulatory compliance: You avoid European fines and customs stoppages by having a platform that strictly complies with sustainability regulations.
  • Downtime-free performance: It supports millions of simultaneous scans without adding a single megabyte of load to your main server or internal ERP.
  • Commercial differentiation: You position yourself to large corporate buyers as a technologically advanced, transparent, and friction-free supplier.
